summary: Accessibility contrast across SDK components (templ and Solid UI): form labels and tertiary text are gray-500; badge, alert, danger-button and error text use shades that reach 4.5:1 in both themes; outline and ghost buttons, nav tabs, segmented tabs and description-list rows read correctly in dark; progress text is dark on the green fill and the bar has an accessible name; Solid Dropdown triggers are no longer nested buttons and Combobox/SearchSelect reference an active option only while open. The whole Solid UI gallery now passes the axe gate in every state, theme and viewport.
